name: Some Beaches (Laketown, UT) Chipotle Shrimp Wrap (Chili-Lime Crema Warning)
whyItWorks: Contains concentrated raw lime juice (citrus acid), spicy chipotle chili peppers, and deep-fried breaded shrimp. High risk for heartburn, mucosal burning, and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during active flareups. If ordering in remission, ask for grilled chicken instead of fried shrimp and sub ranch for the spicy chili-lime crema.
watchOuts: Chili-lime crema contains acidic lime juice and spicy chipotle peppers
